name: smwgraphics-spinning-boo
title: Spinning Boo
description:
In commemoration to Mr.Swit... oh sorry, "Mr.Witchy" event from the SMWCentral Discord Server, I made this spinning boo from the final games.

It can be used as a little funny secret or as an indicator for spinjumping or something like that.

(Original animation by Jammerjab)

[NOTE: if you are going to use the sample level to see how it looks, note that the page where the exanimation was inserted is 0x5:500].

Boo!
